description_en: Performs a paged query on the version update records of the built-in application signature library and returns the paging results in descending sequence of update time. Each record corresponds to an incremental update of the signature library and includes the list of application programs added or updated in this update
description_zh: 分页查询内置应用特征库的版本更新动态，按更新时间倒序返回。每条动态对应一次特征库差量更新，包含本次新增或更新的应用程序列表
name: ListApplicationUpdateDynamics

parameters.help_en:
The language of the returned information. Valid values:
zh: Chinese. This is the default value.
en: English.
This parameter determines whether the update description and application name are returned in Chinese or English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言。取值：
zh：中文，为默认值。
en：英文。
该参数决定更新说明与应用名称使用中文或英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value must be greater than or equal to 1. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。取值需大于等于1，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

Dynamics.description_en: The list of update records for the application signature library, sorted in descending order of update time
Dynamics.description_zh: 应用特征库更新动态列表，按更新时间倒序排列

Applications.description_en: The list of applications added or updated in this update
Applications.description_zh: 本次新增或更新的应用程序列表

ApplicationId.description_en: The ID of the application in the built-in application signature library
ApplicationId.description_zh: 内置应用特征库中的应用程序ID

ApplicationName.description_en: The name of the application. The name is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
ApplicationName.description_zh: 应用程序名称，按Lang参数返回中文或英文名称

DynamicInfo.description_en: The update description. The description is returned in Chinese or English based on the Lang parameter
DynamicInfo.description_zh: 更新说明，按Lang参数返回中文或英文文案
DynamicInfo.example: 新增钉钉等1个应用特征库

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the signature library was updated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 本次特征库更新的时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of update records that meet the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合过滤条件的更新动态总数
